tools.name: jira_get_current_user
tools.description: Return the signed-in Jira user (accountId, name, email, time zone). Jira: GET /myself.

tools.name: jira_find_users
tools.description: Search users by name or email fragment. Returns accountId values for other tools. Jira: GET /user/search.

tools.name: jira_search_issues
tools.description: Search issues with JQL (for example "project = PROJ AND status = 'In Progress'"). Returns one page plus nextPageToken. Default fields: summary, status, assignee, priority, issuetype, project, updated, labels. Jira: POST /search/jql.

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.description: Return one issue with its fields (summary, status, assignee, priority, description). Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_comments
tools.description: List the comments on an issue. Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_transitions
tools.description: List the workflow transitions open for an issue now (use the id with jira_transition_issue). Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_changelog
tools.description: List the change history of an issue (who changed which field, and when). Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/changelog.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_worklogs
tools.description: List the time-tracking worklogs on an issue. Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/worklog.

tools.name: jira_search_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by a name or key fragment. Jira: GET /project/search.

tools.name: jira_get_project
tools.description: Return one project (key, name, lead, issue types). Jira: GET /project/{projectIdOrKey}.

tools.name: jira_get_project_statuses
tools.description: List the statuses used by each issue type in one project. Jira: GET /project/{projectIdOrKey}/statuses.

tools.name: jira_list_fields
tools.description: List all system and custom fields with their ids (use these ids in the fields parameters). Jira: GET /field.

tools.name: jira_list_priorities
tools.description: List the issue priorities (names and ids) of the site. Jira: GET /priority/search.

tools.name: jira_list_issue_types
tools.description: List the issue types the signed-in user can see (Bug, Task, Story, and so on). Jira: GET /issuetype.

tools.name: jira_list_statuses
tools.description: List all workflow statuses of the site. Jira: GET /status.

tools.name: jira_get_my_filters
tools.description: List the saved filters owned by the signed-in user; with includeFavourites, also their favourite filters. Jira: GET /filter/my.

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.description: WRITE: create one issue in a project. Plain-text description. Jira: POST /issue. Only creates; does not edit or delete.

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add one plain-text comment to an issue. Jira: POST /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment. Does not edit or delete comments.

tools.name: jira_transition_issue
tools.description: WRITE: move an issue to a new status by transition id (from jira_get_issue_transitions). Jira: POST /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: jira_get_current_user, jira_find_users, jira_search_issues, jira_get_issue, jira_get_issue_comments, jira_get_issue_transitions, jira_get_issue_changelog, jira_get_issue_worklogs, jira_get_project, jira_get_project_statuses, jira_list_priorities, jira_list_issue_types · Public sink: jira_get_current_user, jira_find_users, jira_search_issues, jira_create_issue, jira_add_comment, jira_transition_issue · Destructive: jira_create_issue, jira_add_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: jira_get_current_user, jira_find_users, jira_search_issues, jira_get_issue, jira_get_issue_comments, jira_get_issue_transitions, jira_get_issue_changelog, jira_get_issue_worklogs, jira_get_project, jira_get_project_statuses, jira_list_priorities, jira_list_issue_types · Public sink: jira_get_current_user, jira_find_users, jira_search_issues, jira_create_issue, jira_add_comment, jira_transition_issue · Destructive: jira_create_issue, jira_add_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
